cpu_win32_priority.Name: CPU priority for games (Win32PrioritySeparation)
cpu_win32_priority.Description: Sets a short time quantum with a high foreground boost (0x26) instead of the default 0x02.
cpu_win32_priority.Benefits: More consistent frame times and fewer micro-stutters, because the game gets CPU time first.
cpu_win32_priority.SideEffects: Background programs receive less CPU time while gaming.

cpu_disable_power_throttling.Name: Disable Power Throttling
cpu_disable_power_throttling.Description: Turns off the Power Throttling mechanism that forces background apps onto lower CPU clocks.
cpu_disable_power_throttling.Benefits: Background tasks (antivirus, launchers, streams) no longer slow the game down with reduced clocks.
cpu_disable_power_throttling.SideEffects: Slight increase in power draw on battery-powered laptops.

cpu_unpark_cores.Name: Unpark all CPU cores (Core Parking Off)
cpu_unpark_cores.Description: Forbids core parking (ValueMax = 0) and requires 100% of cores unparked in the active power scheme.
cpu_unpark_cores.Benefits: Removes wake-up latency of parked cores for smoother FPS and snappier response.
cpu_unpark_cores.SideEffects: Higher idle CPU temperatures; not recommended for laptops with weak cooling.

cpu_svchost_split.Name: Merge services into svchost (64 GB threshold)
cpu_svchost_split.Description: Raises SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB to 64 GB so Windows stops splitting services into dozens of svchost.exe.
cpu_svchost_split.Benefits: Fewer processes, lower memory usage and a faster Task Manager.
cpu_svchost_split.SideEffects: Recommended for systems with 16 GB of RAM or more.

cpu_disable_mitigations_spectre.Name: Disable Spectre/Meltdown software mitigations
cpu_disable_mitigations_spectre.Description: Sets FeatureSettingsOverride = 3 and FeatureSettingsOverrideMask = 3, disabling software CPU vulnerability mitigations.
cpu_disable_mitigations_spectre.Benefits: Recovers 5-15% of CPU performance lost to Spectre/Meltdown checks.
cpu_disable_mitigations_spectre.SideEffects: Lowers protection against CPU architecture attacks. Reboot required.

gpu_enable_hags.Name: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
gpu_enable_hags.Description: Enables HAGS (HwSchMode = 2) so the GPU manages the frame queue itself.
gpu_enable_hags.Benefits: Lower output latency and more stable frame times in demanding games.
gpu_enable_hags.SideEffects: Reboot required. Artifacts are possible on very old drivers.

gpu_tdr_delay.Name: Increase GPU driver timeout (TDR)
gpu_tdr_delay.Description: Raises TdrDelay and TdrDdiDelay to 10 seconds so the driver stops dropping out on long shader workloads.
gpu_tdr_delay.Benefits: Eliminates "display driver stopped responding" crashes in heavy games.
gpu_tdr_delay.SideEffects: If the driver truly hangs, the screen stays frozen longer before recovery.

gpu_nvidia_telemetry.Name: Disable NVIDIA telemetry
gpu_nvidia_telemetry.Description: Stops the NvTelemetryContainer service, disables NvTmMon/NvTmRep scheduled tasks and NVIDIA data collection registry keys.
gpu_nvidia_telemetry.Benefits: Fewer background processes plus lower disk and network load while gaming.
gpu_nvidia_telemetry.SideEffects: NVIDIA Control Panel keeps working. Requires an NVIDIA driver.

gpu_amd_ulps_off.Name: Disable AMD Ultra Low Power State (ULPS)
gpu_amd_ulps_off.Description: Sets EnableUlps = 0 on every AMD display adapter, disabling deep idle GPU power saving.
gpu_amd_ulps_off.Benefits: Removes FPS drops and stutter when the GPU wakes up from ULPS.
gpu_amd_ulps_off.SideEffects: The GPU draws 2-4 W more at idle. Requires an AMD driver.

gpu_mpo_disable.Name: Disable Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO)
gpu_mpo_disable.Description: Sets OverlayTestMode = 5 in the DWM key, disabling hardware multi-plane overlay.
gpu_mpo_disable.Benefits: Fixes flickering, black screens and stutter in browsers and Discord on NVIDIA/AMD.
gpu_mpo_disable.SideEffects: Alt+Tab switching may take a fraction of a second longer.

game_mmcss_profile.Name: MMCSS gaming profile (System Responsiveness)
game_mmcss_profile.Description: Lifts the multimedia scheduler limits (SystemResponsiveness = 0), disables network throttling and sets high priority for the "Games" task profile.
game_mmcss_profile.Benefits: The game gets top GPU, disk and network priority with fewer latency spikes.
game_mmcss_profile.SideEffects: Background multimedia services run at lower priority.

game_disable_fso_dvr.Name: Disable GameDVR and Fullscreen Optimizations
game_disable_fso_dvr.Description: Turns off background GameDVR recording, Xbox Game Bar and Fullscreen Optimizations (FSE) globally.
game_disable_fso_dvr.Benefits: True exclusive fullscreen gaming with higher FPS and lower input latency.
game_disable_fso_dvr.SideEffects: Clip recording via Win+Alt+G stops working (OBS and ShadowPlay still work).

game_raw_mouse_input.Name: Raw mouse input (no acceleration)
game_raw_mouse_input.Description: Disables mouse acceleration (MouseSpeed/Threshold = 0) for a strict 1:1 movement curve.
game_raw_mouse_input.Benefits: More accurate flicks and consistent aim in shooters.
game_raw_mouse_input.SideEffects: Cursor movement becomes fully linear; takes a day or two to get used to.

game_disable_sticky_keys.Name: Disable Sticky Keys popups in games
game_disable_sticky_keys.Description: Turns off the Sticky/Filter/Toggle Keys dialogs that appear after pressing Shift five times.
game_disable_sticky_keys.Benefits: No Windows popup can kick you out of fullscreen while gaming.
game_disable_sticky_keys.SideEffects: Keyboard accessibility features stay available through Control Panel.

game_nagle_tcp_nodelay.Name: Disable Nagle's algorithm (low ping)
game_nagle_tcp_nodelay.Description: Sets TcpAckFrequency = 1, TCPNoDelay = 1 and TcpDelAckTicks = 0 on all active network interfaces.
game_nagle_tcp_nodelay.Benefits: Small packets are sent immediately, lowering ping in online games.
game_nagle_tcp_nodelay.SideEffects: A slight increase in the number of service packets on the network.

tel_disable_diagtrack.Name: Disable DiagTrack telemetry
tel_disable_diagtrack.Description: Stops and disables the DiagTrack and dmwappushservice services and sets AllowTelemetry = 0.
tel_disable_diagtrack.Benefits: Less background disk, network and CPU load with better privacy.
tel_disable_diagtrack.SideEffects: Does not affect Windows Update or driver updates.

tel_disable_compattelrunner.Name: Disable Compatibility Appraiser
tel_disable_compattelrunner.Description: Disables the Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater and CEIP Consolidator scheduled tasks.
tel_disable_compattelrunner.Benefits: Removes regular idle CPU and disk usage spikes.
tel_disable_compattelrunner.SideEffects: Compatibility reports are no longer sent to Microsoft.

tel_disable_advertising_id.Name: Disable advertising ID and tracking
tel_disable_advertising_id.Description: Disables the advertising ID, tailored experiences and app launch tracking (Start_TrackProgs).
tel_disable_advertising_id.Benefits: Windows ads and suggestions are no longer based on your activity.

tel_disable_bing_search.Name: Disable Bing search in Start
tel_disable_bing_search.Description: Disables Bing web search and internet suggestions in the Windows search box.
tel_disable_bing_search.Benefits: Search becomes local and instant, with no requests to Microsoft servers.
tel_disable_bing_search.SideEffects: Only local files, apps and settings are searched.

tel_disable_copilot_recall.Name: Disable Copilot and Recall (AI snapshots)
tel_disable_copilot_recall.Description: Disables Windows Copilot and the Recall feature that continuously snapshots your screen for AI search.
tel_disable_copilot_recall.Benefits: No background AI screen recording - better privacy and less SSD wear.
tel_disable_copilot_recall.SideEffects: Copilot and Recall features become unavailable.

ui_classic_context_menu.Name: Classic context menu (Windows 11)
ui_classic_context_menu.Description: Brings back the full classic right-click menu without the "Show more options" entry.
ui_classic_context_menu.Benefits: Instant access to every command with no WinUI menu delay.
ui_classic_context_menu.SideEffects: Disables the new Windows 11 menu design.

ui_instant_menus_animations.Name: Instant menus, no animations
ui_instant_menus_animations.Description: Sets MenuShowDelay = 0 and disables taskbar and tooltip animations.
ui_instant_menus_animations.Benefits: Menus and the taskbar react instantly, making the shell feel faster.
ui_instant_menus_animations.SideEffects: Animated menu and tooltip appearance is gone.

ui_show_file_extensions.Name: Show file extensions and hidden files
ui_show_file_extensions.Description: Enables known file extensions and reveals hidden files in File Explorer.
ui_show_file_extensions.Benefits: Real file types are visible (e.g. photo.jpg.exe) - safer and more convenient.
ui_show_file_extensions.SideEffects: System and hidden files appear in Explorer.

ui_auto_end_tasks.Name: Auto-close hung applications
ui_auto_end_tasks.Description: Sets AutoEndTasks = 1, HungAppTimeout = 1000 and WaitToKillServiceTimeout = 2000 ms.
ui_auto_end_tasks.Benefits: Shutdown and reboot finish instantly without "End task" dialogs.
ui_auto_end_tasks.SideEffects: Unsaved data in hung apps may be lost.

ui_disable_transparency_shake.Name: Disable transparency and Aero Shake
ui_disable_transparency_shake.Description: Disables window transparency (EnableTransparency = 0) and the Aero Shake gesture.
ui_disable_transparency_shake.Benefits: Less GPU/CPU work when drawing windows and no accidental window minimizing.
ui_disable_transparency_shake.SideEffects: The interface becomes solid and opaque.

sec_disable_vbs_hvci.Name: Disable VBS and Memory Integrity (HVCI)
sec_disable_vbs_hvci.Description: Disables Virtualization-Based Security, Memory Integrity and the hypervisor (bcdedit hypervisorlaunchtype off).
sec_disable_vbs_hvci.Benefits: Adds +5-10% FPS in games by removing kernel virtualization overhead.
sec_disable_vbs_hvci.SideEffects: Weakens kernel protection; Hyper-V, WSL2 and Sandbox stop working. Reboot required.

sec_disable_smartscreen.Name: Disable SmartScreen filter
sec_disable_smartscreen.Description: Turns off SmartScreen app and web content checks for the system and Explorer.
sec_disable_smartscreen.Benefits: Downloaded files run immediately without "Windows protected your PC" prompts.
sec_disable_smartscreen.SideEffects: You are responsible for the safety of downloaded files.

sec_uac_no_dimming.Name: UAC without screen dimming
sec_uac_no_dimming.Description: Disables the UAC secure desktop (PromptOnSecureDesktop = 0) while keeping the admin prompt.
sec_uac_no_dimming.Benefits: The UAC window appears instantly with no dimming or freeze.
sec_uac_no_dimming.SideEffects: Other processes could in theory spoof the UAC dialog, since the secure desktop is off.

sec_disable_smb1_netbios.Name: Disable SMBv1 and NetBIOS
sec_disable_smb1_netbios.Description: Disables the legacy SMBv1 protocol and the mrxsmb10 driver - the source of WannaCry-style worms.
sec_disable_smb1_netbios.Benefits: Protects the PC from network-propagating malware over SMBv1.
sec_disable_smb1_netbios.SideEffects: Very old NAS devices and printers that require SMBv1 become inaccessible.

sec_disable_autorun.Name: Block USB autorun
sec_disable_autorun.Description: Sets NoDriveTypeAutoRun = 255, fully blocking Autorun/Autoplay for all drive types.
sec_disable_autorun.Benefits: USB sticks and external drives can no longer run malware automatically.
sec_disable_autorun.SideEffects: Drives must be opened manually via File Explorer.

pwr_ultimate_performance.Name: Ultimate Performance power plan
pwr_ultimate_performance.Description: Unlocks and activates the hidden "Ultimate Performance" power scheme.
pwr_ultimate_performance.Benefits: CPU and disks stay at maximum clocks with no idle downclocking.
pwr_ultimate_performance.SideEffects: Higher power draw and temperatures; not suitable for laptop battery use.

pwr_disable_hibernation.Name: Disable hibernation (hiberfil.sys)
pwr_disable_hibernation.Description: Disables the hibernation file (powercfg /h off, HibernateEnabled = 0); Fast Startup is handled by its own tweak.
pwr_disable_hibernation.Benefits: Frees several GB of SSD space (hiberfil.sys) and avoids dual-boot file issues.
pwr_disable_hibernation.SideEffects: Hibernation and Fast Startup become unavailable (regular sleep still works).

pwr_disable_usb_suspend.Name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
pwr_disable_usb_suspend.Description: Disables selective USB port suspension in the active power scheme (both AC and DC).
pwr_disable_usb_suspend.Benefits: Mice, keyboards and headsets no longer disconnect for a second while gaming.
pwr_disable_usb_suspend.SideEffects: A slight increase in USB peripheral power draw.

pwr_pcie_aspm_off.Name: Disable PCIe ASPM (Link State Power)
pwr_pcie_aspm_off.Description: Sets PCI Express link state power management to Off for maximum bandwidth.
pwr_pcie_aspm_off.Benefits: Maximum bus speed for the GPU and NVMe drives.
pwr_pcie_aspm_off.SideEffects: Slight increase in power draw and chipset temperature.

pwr_ntfs_ssd_tuning.Name: NTFS tuning for SSD
pwr_ntfs_ssd_tuning.Description: Disables 8.3 short names (disable8dot3) and last access time updates.
pwr_ntfs_ssd_tuning.Benefits: Fewer writes to the SSD and faster directory handling with many files.
pwr_ntfs_ssd_tuning.SideEffects: Legacy DOS programs that rely on 8.3 short names stop working.

cpu_disable_cstates_idle.Name: Disable deep C-States (zero core wake-up latency)
cpu_disable_cstates_idle.Description: Forbids deep core sleep transitions (IDLEDISABLE = 1) in the active power scheme.
cpu_disable_cstates_idle.Benefits: Zero wake-up latency for CPU cores - more consistent 1% Low frametimes in heavy scenes.
cpu_disable_cstates_idle.SideEffects: Higher idle power draw and CPU temperatures.

cpu_boost_mode_aggressive.Name: Aggressive CPU Boost mode
cpu_boost_mode_aggressive.Description: Sets Processor Performance Boost Mode to Aggressive (PERFBOOSTMODE = 2) and unhides the setting in the power scheme.
cpu_boost_mode_aggressive.Benefits: The CPU holds its maximum boost clocks far more eagerly, with fewer clock drops in games.
cpu_boost_mode_aggressive.SideEffects: Higher power consumption and CPU temperatures.

cpu_disable_memory_compression.Name: Disable RAM memory compression
cpu_disable_memory_compression.Description: Turns off Memory Compression (Disable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression), which burns CPU cycles compressing RAM pages.
cpu_disable_memory_compression.Benefits: Less CPU overhead when memory fills up - recommended for systems with 16 GB of RAM or more.
cpu_disable_memory_compression.SideEffects: On 8 GB systems the page file may be used more aggressively.

cpu_large_system_cache.Name: System cache and kernel kept in RAM (LargeSystemCache)
cpu_large_system_cache.Description: Enables LargeSystemCache and DisablePagingExecutive so drivers and the kernel stay in physical RAM instead of paging to disk.
cpu_large_system_cache.Benefits: Fewer disk round-trips during task switching for a snappier system response.
cpu_large_system_cache.SideEffects: Requires 16 GB of RAM or more; not recommended on weak machines.

cpu_hetero_scheduler_x3d.Name: Heterogeneous scheduling for Ryzen X3D and Intel P/E-cores
cpu_hetero_scheduler_x3d.Description: Sets HETEROPOLICY = 4 (prefer performance cores / the 3D V-Cache CCD) and SCHEDPOLICY = 2 in the active power scheme.
cpu_hetero_scheduler_x3d.Benefits: Games are scheduled onto the faster CCD or P-cores more often - higher and steadier FPS.
cpu_hetero_scheduler_x3d.SideEffects: Mainly benefits Ryzen X3D and Intel 12th gen or newer; no effect on older CPUs.

gpu_enable_msi_mode.Name: MSI mode (Message Signaled Interrupts) for GPUs
gpu_enable_msi_mode.Description: Automatically enables MSISupported = 1 and high interrupt priority (DevicePriority = 3) for every PCI display adapter.
gpu_enable_msi_mode.Benefits: Lower GPU interrupt handling latency for a steadier frametime and higher performance.
gpu_enable_msi_mode.SideEffects: Reboot required; MSI can be unstable on some legacy platforms.

gpu_nvidia_force_p0_state.Name: NVIDIA: locked P0 state (no downclocking)
gpu_nvidia_force_p0_state.Description: Sets DisableDynamicPstate = 1 on NVIDIA adapters, disabling dynamic P-State downclocking.
gpu_nvidia_force_p0_state.Benefits: The GPU no longer drops clocks in light 3D scenes - no FPS dip when entering a game.
gpu_nvidia_force_p0_state.SideEffects: Higher idle GPU power draw and temperatures.

gpu_amd_disable_stutter_features.Name: AMD: disable power-saving stutter features
gpu_amd_disable_stutter_features.Description: On AMD adapters disables ASPM L0s/L1, thermal auto-throttling and enables direct DMA copy.
gpu_amd_disable_stutter_features.Benefits: Removes sudden micro-stutter and GPU clock drops in heavy scenes.
gpu_amd_disable_stutter_features.SideEffects: Slightly higher power draw; requires an AMD driver.

gpu_dwm_frame_latency.Name: Smaller DWM frame queue
gpu_dwm_frame_latency.Description: Limits the Desktop Window Manager composition queue (MaxQueuedBuffers = 2) and forces effects on (ForceEffectMode = 2).
gpu_dwm_frame_latency.Benefits: Lower desktop composition latency on the desktop and in windowed games.
gpu_dwm_frame_latency.SideEffects: Requires an explorer.exe/DWM restart to fully apply.

gpu_dx_shader_cache_unlimited.Name: Unlimited DirectX shader cache
gpu_dx_shader_cache_unlimited.Description: Removes the artificial DirectX shader cache limit (ShaderCacheLimit = 0) and enables the NVIDIA GL cache policy.
gpu_dx_shader_cache_unlimited.Benefits: Fewer micro-stutters from recompiling shaders after every driver update.
gpu_dx_shader_cache_unlimited.SideEffects: The shader cache uses more disk space.

game_mouse_kbd_data_queue.Name: Smaller mouse and keyboard input buffers
game_mouse_kbd_data_queue.Description: Shrinks the mouclass and kbdclass driver queues to 20 packets instead of the default 100.
game_mouse_kbd_data_queue.Benefits: Lower peripheral latency for faster mouse and keyboard response in shooters.
game_mouse_kbd_data_queue.SideEffects: Reboot required; very slow USB devices may drop input events.

game_bcdedit_timer_tick.Name: Fixed kernel timer tick (BCD)
game_bcdedit_timer_tick.Description: Enables useplatformtick and disabledynamictick, disabling synthetic timers (a reboot is required).
game_bcdedit_timer_tick.Benefits: More even frame pacing and a steadier 1% Low in timer-sensitive engines.
game_bcdedit_timer_tick.SideEffects: Some laptops draw slightly more power at idle.

game_global_timer_resolution.Name: Global timer resolution (0.5 ms)
game_global_timer_resolution.Description: Enables GlobalTimerResolutionRequests so high-precision timer requests apply to the whole process instead of a single thread.
game_global_timer_resolution.Benefits: Every game thread gets precise timers - fewer hitches on Windows 11.
game_global_timer_resolution.SideEffects: Windows 11 only; slightly higher power consumption.

game_csrss_high_priority.Name: High priority for csrss.exe
game_csrss_high_priority.Description: Sets CpuPriorityClass = 4 and IoPriority = 3 for csrss.exe, which handles raw mouse and keyboard input.
game_csrss_high_priority.Benefits: Fewer input packets lost under load - more consistent multiplayer responsiveness.
game_csrss_high_priority.SideEffects: Reboot required; gives a system process elevated priority.

game_network_rss_rsc_tuning.Name: Gaming network stack (RSS/RSC)
game_network_rss_rsc_tuning.Description: Enables RSS, disables RSC/ECN and speeds up SYN retransmissions via netsh.
game_network_rss_rsc_tuning.Benefits: Lower and more consistent ping in online games with fewer packet losses.
game_network_rss_rsc_tuning.SideEffects: Disabling RSC may slightly reduce large download throughput.

tel_disable_wer_error_reporting.Name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
tel_disable_wer_error_reporting.Description: Disables Windows Error Reporting (Disabled = 1) and stops the WerSvc service.
tel_disable_wer_error_reporting.Benefits: No background crash dumps or report uploads - less disk load.
tel_disable_wer_error_reporting.SideEffects: Diagnosing app crash causes becomes harder.

tel_disable_cloud_clipboard_sync.Name: Disable cloud clipboard sync
tel_disable_cloud_clipboard_sync.Description: Disables clipboard sync across devices and the activity history stored in your Microsoft account.
tel_disable_cloud_clipboard_sync.Benefits: Clipboard contents and your activity history never leave the PC.
tel_disable_cloud_clipboard_sync.SideEffects: Copy-paste between your own devices via the cloud clipboard stops working.

tel_disable_wifi_sense_location.Name: Disable Wi-Fi Sense and background location
tel_disable_wifi_sense_location.Description: Disables Wi-Fi Sense hotspot auto-connect and the location services.
tel_disable_wifi_sense_location.Benefits: Wi-Fi passwords are not shared with contacts and location is not tracked in the background.
tel_disable_wifi_sense_location.SideEffects: Weather, maps and Find My Device will not detect location automatically.

tel_disable_delivery_optimization_p2p.Name: Disable P2P update sharing
tel_disable_delivery_optimization_p2p.Description: Sets DODownloadMode = 0 so Windows Update never uses your connection to share updates with other PCs.
tel_disable_delivery_optimization_p2p.Benefits: Updates are downloaded from Microsoft servers only - less bandwidth used.
tel_disable_delivery_optimization_p2p.SideEffects: Local-network update download speeds may be lower.

tel_disable_feedback_siuf.Name: Disable "Send Feedback" popups
tel_disable_feedback_siuf.Description: Disables the periodic feedback request engine (SIUF) and feedback notifications.
tel_disable_feedback_siuf.Benefits: Windows stops nagging with feedback popups.
tel_disable_feedback_siuf.SideEffects: None; the feature is purely informational.

ui_explorer_open_this_pc.Name: File Explorer opens "This PC"
ui_explorer_open_this_pc.Description: Sets LaunchTo = 1 and hides recent and frequent files from the Explorer start page.
ui_explorer_open_this_pc.Benefits: Explorer opens where you actually need it - without clutter and history lists.
ui_explorer_open_this_pc.SideEffects: Recent files are no longer listed on the Explorer home page.

ui_clean_taskbar_widgets_chat.Name: Hide taskbar Widgets, Task View and Chat
ui_clean_taskbar_widgets_chat.Description: Removes the Widgets board (weather/news), the Task View button and the Chat icon from the taskbar.
ui_clean_taskbar_widgets_chat.Benefits: A clean taskbar with no background widget and news load.
ui_clean_taskbar_widgets_chat.SideEffects: Task View stays available via Win+Tab.

ui_disable_lockscreen_tips_ads.Name: Disable lock screen ads and tips
ui_disable_lockscreen_tips_ads.Description: Turns off "fun facts", tips and suggested apps on the lock screen and in the Start menu.
ui_disable_lockscreen_tips_ads.Benefits: No intrusive Windows ads or suggestions at all.
ui_disable_lockscreen_tips_ads.SideEffects: The lock screen shows only your configured images.

ui_disable_shortcut_arrow_suffix.Name: No "- Shortcut" suffix on new shortcuts
ui_disable_shortcut_arrow_suffix.Description: Changes the shortcut naming template to "%s.lnk", removing the "- Shortcut" / "- Ярлик" suffix.
ui_disable_shortcut_arrow_suffix.Benefits: New shortcuts are created with a clean name - no manual renaming needed.
ui_disable_shortcut_arrow_suffix.SideEffects: Works on Windows 11 22H2 and newer only.

ui_enable_end_task_taskbar.Name: Taskbar "End Task" button
ui_enable_end_task_taskbar.Description: Enables TaskbarEndTask = 1 - the Windows 11 developer feature that closes hung apps from the taskbar menu.
ui_enable_end_task_taskbar.Benefits: Kill a hung app straight from the taskbar without opening Task Manager.
ui_enable_end_task_taskbar.SideEffects: The entry appears in the right-click menu of every taskbar app.

sec_disable_remote_assistance_rdp.Name: Disable Remote Assistance and RDP
sec_disable_remote_assistance_rdp.Description: Blocks incoming Remote Assistance invitations and Remote Desktop connections and disables the TermService service.
sec_disable_remote_assistance_rdp.Benefits: Closes a popular remote access vector used by attackers.
sec_disable_remote_assistance_rdp.SideEffects: Built-in RDP access to this PC stops working (RustDesk/AnyDesk still work).

sec_disable_llmnr_wpns.Name: Disable LLMNR and WPAD
sec_disable_llmnr_wpns.Description: Disables Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution and automatic proxy discovery (WPAD).
sec_disable_llmnr_wpns.Benefits: Protects against hash-stealing LLMNR/NBT-NS/WPAD relay attacks.
sec_disable_llmnr_wpns.SideEffects: Very old local services may need a DNS suffix.

sec_disable_driver_vuln_blocklist.Name: Disable vulnerable driver blocklist
sec_disable_driver_vuln_blocklist.Description: Turns off VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable so monitoring and tuning drivers (Afterburner, Ryzen Master, FanControl) load again.
sec_disable_driver_vuln_blocklist.Benefits: Removes the driver block that breaks hardware monitoring and fan control tools.
sec_disable_driver_vuln_blocklist.SideEffects: Reduces protection against known vulnerable drivers.

sec_disable_windows_script_host.Name: Disable Windows Script Host
sec_disable_windows_script_host.Description: Sets Enabled = 0 for Windows Script Host, blocking .vbs and .js script execution.
sec_disable_windows_script_host.Benefits: Protects against a common ransomware dropper technique using .vbs/.js files.
sec_disable_windows_script_host.SideEffects: Legitimate .vbs/.js scripts will not run either.

sec_disable_fth_heap.Name: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap (FTH)
sec_disable_fth_heap.Description: Sets Enabled = 0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\FTH, disabling the diagnostic shim Windows attaches to program .exe files after a first crash.
sec_disable_fth_heap.Benefits: Games no longer inherit a slow shim hook after a crash — stable FPS without reinstalling.
sec_disable_fth_heap.SideEffects: Windows will not collect FTH diagnostics for repeated application crashes.

pwr_disable_fast_startup.Name: Disable Windows Fast Startup
pwr_disable_fast_startup.Description: Sets HiberbootEnabled = 0 so Windows performs a full kernel reload on shutdown.
pwr_disable_fast_startup.Benefits: Driver and DPC bugs from previous sessions no longer carry over between boots.
pwr_disable_fast_startup.SideEffects: Windows may take 1-3 seconds longer to start.

pwr_nvme_ssd_idle_timeout_off.Name: Disable NVMe/SSD idle timeout
pwr_nvme_ssd_idle_timeout_off.Description: Sets the primary disk idle timeout to Never (0) in the active power scheme.
pwr_nvme_ssd_idle_timeout_off.Benefits: The drive never sleeps, so there are no wake-up micro-freezes.
pwr_nvme_ssd_idle_timeout_off.SideEffects: Slightly higher idle SSD power draw.

pwr_ntfs_memory_usage_boost.Name: Larger NTFS memory cache
pwr_ntfs_memory_usage_boost.Description: Enables memoryusage = 2 and NtfsMemoryUsage = 2 for a bigger file system paged-pool cache.
pwr_ntfs_memory_usage_boost.Benefits: Faster directory listing and asset streaming in open-world games.
pwr_ntfs_memory_usage_boost.SideEffects: The file system reserves more RAM.

pwr_disable_storage_sense.Name: Disable Storage Sense
pwr_disable_storage_sense.Description: Turns off automatic background disk cleanup sweeps (01 = 0) while gaming.
pwr_disable_storage_sense.Benefits: No sudden freezes from background temporary-file cleanup.
pwr_disable_storage_sense.SideEffects: Temporary files must be cleaned manually.

pwr_usb_hubs_power_saving_off.Name: Disable USB hub power saving
pwr_usb_hubs_power_saving_off.Description: Disables EnhancedPowerManagementEnabled and AllowIdleIrpInD3 on USB hubs and HID devices.
pwr_usb_hubs_power_saving_off.Benefits: Mice, keyboards and headsets never sleep or drop out while gaming.
pwr_usb_hubs_power_saving_off.SideEffects: Slightly higher USB peripheral power draw.
